<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex47032023-09-121" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
            <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (5a5-5b2) (p. 217-218)"/>
             <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4795">shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bsgom don rin chen spungs pa</rs> zhes bya ba <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">shAkya'i dge slong nam mkha' grags</rs> kyis sbyar ba'o || || <pb n="5a"/><lb n="5b1"/> <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4411">dam pas bsngags pa'i gnas dpal snar thang gi dben gnas</rs> su <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen snar thang pa bdun par byon pa</rs>'i phyag dpe las <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5788">btsun pa grags pa rgyal mtshan</rs><anchor xml:id="a1"/> <lb n="5b2"/> gyis <hi rendition="#Time">'brug gi lo ma rgyu'i zla ba'i yar tshes bcu<anchor xml:id="a2"/></hi> la bris so || <abbr>bdag gzhan</abbr> <abbr>thams cad</abbr> smin cing grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol || bkra shis | </seg></TEI>
source: 2_047_03 Shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgom don rin chen spungs pa.xml
